concepts.definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2023-24 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year (prior-year comparison block). Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.16 = 16%), not a whole percentage; a negative value indicates a gap favouring women. It is a pay gap, not a pay level or business income. Blank means no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: The shortlisted dyn.employer_reporting_unit.average_base_salary_gpg is scoped to the 2024-25 reporting year; this column is the 2023-24 comparison value, so reusing the current-year concept would change its temporal scope.

concepts.definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2023-24 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year (prior-year comparison block). Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.16 = 16%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women. Blank means no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: The shortlisted dyn.employer_reporting_unit.average_total_remuneration_gpg is scoped to the 2024-25 reporting year; this column is the 2023-24 comparison value, so reuse would change the temporal scope of the measure.
